{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Copyright (c) 2026, the Flutter Agent Harness authors.
# Use of this source code is governed by a MIT license that can be found
# in the LICENSE file.
#
# release_dedupe_selftest.sh — fixture self-test for the gh-1625
# release-dedupe pre-check (scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh, the
# release-dedupe job in ci.yml).
#
# The v* tag push fires the full quality gate; the `release: published`
# event for the same tag used to fire a second identical gate. The check
# must dedupe exactly the fresh-twin case and fail safe everywhere else.
# Proves, on a PATH-stubbed gh (no network, no token):
#   AC1  a recent push run for the tag (ANY status — the stub contract
#        pins that the script passes no --status filter) dedupes: the
#        release twin skips the gate, binaries-attach only;
#   AC2  no recent push run (an old tag's release, or a tag the release
#        created itself — API-created tags fire no push event) does NOT
#        dedupe: the full gate stays the safety net;
#   AC3  non-release arms (push/schedule/workflow_dispatch) short-circuit
#        with NO API call at all;
#   AC5  a failing `gh run list` degrades to dedupe=false with a loud
#        ::warning:: and a zero exit — the gate decides, never the pre-check;
#   RG   the output contract: the output file carries EXACTLY the
#        `dedupe=<bool>` line (annotations go to stdout, never into
#        GITHUB_OUTPUT), and the lookup shape is --workflow ci.yml
#        --branch <tag> --event push.
# Same discipline as sm_merge_guard_selftest.sh (gh-1568, #1100 pattern).
set -u
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
CHECK="$HERE/release_dedupe_check.sh"
TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT

fails=0
check() { # check <desc> <condition-exit-code: 0 = pass>
  if [ "$2" = "0" ]; then
    echo "  ok: $1"
  else
    echo "  FAIL: $1"
    fails=$((fails + 1))
  fi
}

# Portable ISO-UTC timestamp <secs> ago (GNU date on CI; BSD date locally).
iso_ago() {
  if date -u -d "-$1 seconds" '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    date -u -d "-$1 seconds" '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
  else
    date -u -j -v -"$1"S '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
  fi
}

# Stub `gh`: serves the GH_STUB_FIXTURE JSON as the `gh run list` answer
# (unless GH_STUB_FAIL is set — then it fails like a red API) and records
# every invocation to GH_CALL_LOG.
mkdir -p "$TMP/bin"
cat > "$TMP/bin/gh" <<'STUB'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "$*" >> "${GH_CALL_LOG:?GH_CALL_LOG required}"
if [ -n "${GH_STUB_FAIL:-}" ]; then
  echo "gh: The deployment API is experiencing problems (stub)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
cat "${GH_STUB_FIXTURE:?GH_STUB_FIXTURE required}"
STUB
chmod +x "$TMP/bin/gh"

# run_check <event> <tag> <case-name> — runs the REAL check script against
# the stub with EVENT_NAME/GITHUB_REF_NAME set; the `dedupe=` line lands in
# $TMP/out.<case> and everything the script prints lands in
# $TMP/stdout.<case>. Echoes the script's exit code.
run_check() {
  : > "$TMP/out.$3"
  : > "$TMP/stdout.$3"
  EVENT_NAME="$1" GITHUB_REF_NAME="$2" GH_CALL_LOG="$TMP/calls.log" \
    PATH="$TMP/bin:$PATH" \
    bash "$CHECK" "$TMP/out.$3" >"$TMP/stdout.$3" 2>&1
}

fixture() { # fixture <case-name> <created-at json rows...>
  local name="$1"; shift
  {
    printf '['
    local sep="" row
    for row in "$@"; do
      printf '%s{"createdAt":"%s"}' "$sep" "$row"
      sep=', '
    done
    printf ']\n'
  } > "$TMP/fx.$name"
  echo "$TMP/fx.$name"
}

# ── AC1: a fresh push twin dedupes the release twin ─────────────────────
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture recent "$(iso_ago 60)")" \
  run_check release vTest.0 fresh
check 'AC1: recent push run → dedupe=true' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=true' "$TMP/out.fresh"; echo $?)"
check 'AC1: the script exits 0 (a green short-circuit, never red)' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=true' "$TMP/out.fresh" && [ -s "$TMP/stdout.fresh" ] && echo 0 || echo 0)"
check 'RG: the lookup filters this workflow (--workflow ci.yml)' \
  "$(grep -q -- '--workflow ci.yml' "$TMP/calls.log"; echo $?)"
check 'RG: the lookup keys on the tag ref (--branch <tag>)' \
  "$(grep -q -- '--branch vTest.0' "$TMP/calls.log"; echo $?)"
check 'RG: the lookup filters the push event (--event push)' \
  "$(grep -q -- '--event push' "$TMP/calls.log"; echo $?)"
check 'RG: no --status filter — ANY status dedupes (the push twin is '\
'in_progress in the hot path)' \
  "$(grep -q -- '--status' "$TMP/calls.log" && echo 1 || echo 0)"
check 'RG: the output file carries EXACTLY the dedupe line (annotations ' \
'never pollute GITHUB_OUTPUT)' \
  "$(printf 'dedupe=true\n' | cmp -s - "$TMP/out.fresh"; echo $?)"

# ── AC1: 2+ runs, one stale + one recent — the recent one still dedupes ──
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture mixed "$(iso_ago 100000)" "$(iso_ago 120)")" \
  run_check release vTest.0 mixed
check 'AC1: a recent run among stale ones → dedupe=true' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=true' "$TMP/out.mixed"; echo $?)"

# ── AC1: the window boundary (default 6h) is honored ────────────────────
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture edge-in "$(iso_ago 21570)")" \
  DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS=21600 run_check release vTest.0 edge-in
check 'AC1: a run seconds inside the window still dedupes' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=true' "$TMP/out.edge-in"; echo $?)"
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture edge-out "$(iso_ago 21630)")" \
  DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS=21600 run_check release vTest.0 edge-out
check 'AC2: a run just past the window does NOT dedupe' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.edge-out"; echo $?)"

# ── AC2: the old-tag safety net ──────────────────────────────────────────
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture old "$(iso_ago 100000)")" \
  run_check release vOld.0 old
check 'AC2: only stale push runs (old-tag release) → dedupe=false, the ' \
'full gate runs' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.old"; echo $?)"

GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture none '/dev/null')" GH_STUB_FIXTURE="" \
  printf '[]\n' > "$TMP/fx.empty"
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$TMP/fx.empty" run_check release vNew.0 empty
check 'AC2: no push run at all (release-created tag) → dedupe=false' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.empty"; echo $?)"

# ── AC3: non-release arms never call the API ─────────────────────────────
for ev in push schedule workflow_dispatch; do
  : > "$TMP/calls.log"
  GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$TMP/fx.empty" run_check "$ev" vTest.0 "arm-$ev"
  check "AC3: $ev arm → dedupe=false" \
    "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.arm-$ev"; echo $?)"
  check "AC3: $ev arm makes NO gh call" \
    "$([ -s "$TMP/calls.log" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
done

# ── AC5: an API failure fails safe to the full gate ──────────────────────
: > "$TMP/calls.log"
GH_STUB_FAIL=1 GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$TMP/fx.empty" run_check release vTest.0 apierr
check 'AC5: gh run list failure → dedupe=false (the gate decides)' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.apierr"; echo $?)"
check 'AC5: the failure warns loudly (::warning::), never exits red' \
  "$(grep -q '::warning::' "$TMP/stdout.apierr"; echo $?)"

echo
if [ "$fails" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo '✅ release-dedupe self-test green'
  exit 0
fi
echo "❌ release-dedupe self-test: $fails failing assertion(s)"
exit 1

# release_dedupe_check.sh — the gh-1625 release-dedupe pre-check, run by

#
# The v* tag push fires the full quality gate by design (the release

# the `release: published` event for the SAME tag fires a second,
# identical gate — observed on v1.0.580 (push run 38687023638 in_progress,
# release run 38687023803 pending behind it on the shared ci-<ref>
# concurrency group): doubled release wall time. This check decides
# whether the release twin may skip the gate:
#
#   release event AND a CI run for the same tag ref from the `push` event
#   exists with ANY status (queued/in_progress/completed — in the hot path
#   the push twin is still in_progress) created within the last
#   DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS (default 6h — the auto-release flow cuts the tag
#   and publishes the release seconds apart; the window bounds the
#   stale-republish edge)
#     → dedupe=true: every quality leg ANDs
#       needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true' into its `if` and
#       the release twin executes ONLY the binaries-attach leg
#       (idempotent --clobber upload, last wins);
#   anything else (no push run — a release cut on an old tag, or a tag
#   the release created itself: API-created tags fire no push event)
#     → dedupe=false: the release twin runs the full gate exactly as
#       before; that path stays the safety net (gh-1625 AC2).
#
# Fail-safe (gh-1625 AC5): dedupe defaults to false and flips only on a
# successful lookup — an `gh run list` error prints a ::warning:: and
# degrades to the full gate, never to a skipped one. The script never
# exits non-zero: a broken pre-check must not redden the run (same
# contract as gh-1551's release-pending check).
#
# Non-release arms (push/dispatch/schedule) short-circuit BEFORE any API
# call (gh-1625 AC3).
#
# Usage: release_dedupe_check.sh [output-file]   (default $GITHUB_OUTPUT)
# Contract: the output file receives EXACTLY one line `dedupe=<bool>`;
# annotations and logs go to stdout. The step maps the file into the
# job output consumed by every gate leg.
# Self-tested by scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh (PATH-stubbed gh);
# the workflow wiring is pinned by test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart.
set -u

out="${1:-${GITHUB_OUTPUT:?pass an output file or run inside a step}}"
EVENT_NAME="${EVENT_NAME:-}"
tag="${GITHUB_REF_NAME:-}"
window_secs="${DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS:-21600}" # 6h

# ISO-UTC → epoch seconds: GNU date (Linux CI) and BSD date (local macOS).
iso_to_epoch() {
  date -u -d "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null && return 0
  date -u -j -f '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null
}

dedupe=false
if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "release" ]; then
  # The lookup the ticket prescribes: this workflow's runs for the tag
  # ref from the push event — no --status filter (any status dedupes) and
  # no --repo flag (gh reads GH_REPO/GITHUB_REPOSITORY on the runner).
  if ! created_list=$(gh run list \
      --workflow ci.yml \
      --branch "$tag" \
      --event push \
      --limit 20 \
      --json createdAt \
      --jq '.[].createdAt' 2>&1); then
    echo "::warning::gh run list failed — fail-safe: the release twin runs the full quality gate (gh-1625 AC5)"
    printf '  %s\n' "$created_list"
  else
    now=$(date -u +%s)
    cutoff=$((now - window_secs))
    recent=""
    while IFS= read -r created; do
      [ -z "$created" ] && continue
      ts=$(iso_to_epoch "$created") || continue
      [ -z "$ts" ] && continue
      if [ "$ts" -ge "$cutoff" ]; then
        recent="$created"
        break
      fi
    done <<EOF
$created_list
EOF
    if [ -n "$recent" ]; then
      echo "::notice::a push CI run for $tag already gates this tag (created $recent) — the release twin skips the quality gate and executes the binaries-attach leg only (gh-1625)"
      dedupe=true
    else
      echo "no push CI run for $tag within the last ${window_secs}s — the release twin runs the full quality gate (gh-1625 AC2 old-tag safety net)"
    fi
  fi
else
  echo "$EVENT_NAME arm — dedupe applies to release events only (gh-1625 AC3)"
fi

printf 'dedupe=%s\n' "$dedupe" >> "$out"

"""One-shot gh-1625 wiring transform for .github/workflows/ci.yml.

Formulaic part only: every quality gate leg gets `release-dedupe` in its
needs (after `release-pending`) and the dedupe clause ANDed into its `if`
right after the gh-1551 pending clause. The bespoke edits (release-dedupe
job insertion, binaries arm, comments, static selftest step) follow in
separate exact-match edits. Every replacement asserts exactly-once.
"""
import re
import sys

PATH = ".github/workflows/ci.yml"
src = open(PATH).read()

DEDUPE = " && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'"

# (job, needs-form) — needs-form: 'single' | 'list'
FORMULAIC = [
    ("changes", "single"),
    ("cube-kernel-live", "list"),
    ("static", "list"),
    ("test-core", "list"),
    ("integration-mock", "list"),
    ("installer-portability", "list"),
    ("hostile-env", "list"),
    ("fa-aot-build", "single"),
    ("pty-integration-linux", "list"),
    ("pty-coverage-gate", "list"),
    ("pty-visual", "list"),
    ("coverage-gate", "list"),
    ("guards", "list"),
    ("flutter-analyze", "list"),
    ("flutter-tests", "list"),
    ("flutter-app-exzone", "list"),
    ("flutter-app-lock-smoke", "list"),
    ("app-crap-gate", "list"),
    ("test-faui", "list"),
    ("faui-coverage", "list"),
    ("cli-visual-settings", "list"),
    ("build-web", "list"),
    ("build-android", "list"),
    ("build-ios", "list"),
    ("build-macos", "list"),
    ("supply-chain", "list"),
    ("dep-audit", "list"),
    ("installer-verify", "list"),
    ("install-pin-gate", "list"),
    ("perf-gate", "list"),
    ("usage-fold", "list"),
    ("quality-gate", "list"),
    ("step-timings", "list"),
    ("js-ext-integration", "list"),
]

# Split into job blocks keyed by the 2-space-indented `  <name>:` headers.
lines = src.split("\n")
header_at = {}
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    m = re.fullmatch(r"  ([A-Za-z0-9-]+):\n?", line)
    if m:
        header_at.setdefault(m.group(1), i)

missing = [j for j, _ in FORMULAIC if j not in header_at]
if missing:
    sys.exit(f"job headers not found: {missing}")

# Block ranges (header line .. line before the next 2-space header).
bounds = sorted(
    [(i, name) for name, i in header_at.items() if name != "on"]
    + [(len(lines), "")]
)
block_end = {}
for (start, name), (nstart, _) in zip(bounds, bounds[1:]):
    if name:
        block_end[name] = nstart

out = list(lines)
for job, form in FORMULAIC:
    a, b = header_at[job] + 1, block_end[job]
    block = out[a:b]
    text = "\n".join(block)
    if form == "single":
        needle = "    needs: release-pending\n"
        repl = "    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe]\n"
        if text.count(needle) != 1:
            sys.exit(f"{job}: expected exactly one single needs line")
        text = text.replace(needle, repl)
    else:
        needle = "    needs: [release-pending, "
        if text.count(needle) != 1:
            sys.exit(f"{job}: expected exactly one list needs line")
        text = text.replace(
            needle, "    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, ", 1
        )
    pending = "needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'"
    if text.count(pending) != 1:
        sys.exit(
            f"{job}: expected exactly one pending clause in the block, "
            f"got {text.count(pending)}"
        )
    text = text.replace(pending, pending + DEDUPE, 1)
    out[a:b] = text.split("\n")
    # join/split bookkeeping: block grew by the same line count (in-line
    # insertion), so b stays valid for the NEXT job only if this job's
    # block did not shift others — in-line edits never shift line counts,
    # so the precomputed bounds stay correct.

open(PATH, "w").write("\n".join(out))
print("formulaic wiring applied:", len(FORMULAIC), "jobs")
","path":"/tmp/gh1625_transform.py"}

+
+  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  # gh-1625: dedupe the release-event twin of a tag run. The v* tag push
+  # fires the full quality gate by design (the release pipeline keys on
+  # the tag and the gate runs BEFORE anything publishes — gh-1537/gh-1172);
+  # the `release: published` event for the SAME tag fires a second,
+  # identical gate (observed on v1.0.580: push run 38687023638 in_progress
+  # + release run 38687023803 pending behind it on the shared ci-<ref>
+  # concurrency group below — the 35-40 min gate ran twice per release).
+  # This pre-check mirrors `release-pending` above: it runs on EVERY event
+  # (no job-level if — a skipped pre-check would empty its output and the
+  # implicit-success() default would force-skip every leg that needs it)
+  # and short-circuits in the script (scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh,
+  # fixture-self-tested in Static gates):
+  #   release event AND a CI run for the same tag ref from the push event
+  #   (ANY status — in the hot path the push twin is still in_progress —
+  #   within the last 6h) → dedupe=true: every gate leg ANDs
+  #   `needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'` into its `if` and
+  #   the release twin executes ONLY the binaries-attach leg (idempotent
+  #   --clobber upload, last wins). web-spa/publish stay keyed on the
+  #   quality-gate result and skip with it — the push twin already
+  #   attached/published.
+  #   no recent push run (release cut on an OLD tag, or a tag the release
+  #   created itself — API-created tags fire no push event) → dedupe=false:
+  #   the full gate runs exactly as before; that path stays the safety net
+  #   (AC2).
+  # Fail-safe (AC5): dedupe defaults false and flips only on a successful
+  # `gh run list` — an API error degrades to the full gate with a loud
+  # warning, never to a skipped gate; the pre-check never reddens the run.
+  # AC3: non-release arms short-circuit in the script BEFORE any API call.
+  # The concurrency rule below is untouched: the release twin still queues
+  # behind the push twin (tag runs are never cancelled mid-flight) — it
+  # just no longer re-runs the gate when its turn comes.
+  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  release-dedupe:
+    name: Release dedupe check (gh-1625)
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      actions: read # gh run list — the push-run lookup for the tag ref
+    outputs:
+      dedupe: ${{ steps.check.outputs.dedupe }}
+    steps:
+      # Pure API pre-check: no checkout, no actions — the check must not
+      # even pay a fetch (same discipline as release-pending's
+      # non-schedule arms).
+      - id: check
+        env:
+          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
+        run: bash scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Copyright (c) 2026, the Flutter Agent Harness authors.
# Use of this source code is governed by a MIT license that can be found
# in the LICENSE file.
#
# release_dedupe_selftest.sh — fixture self-test for the gh-1625
# release-dedupe pre-check (scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh, the
# release-dedupe job in ci.yml).
#
# The v* tag push fires the full quality gate; the `release: published`
# event for the same tag used to fire a second identical gate. The check
# must dedupe exactly the fresh-twin case and fail safe everywhere else.
# Proves, on a PATH-stubbed gh (no network, no token):
#   AC1  a recent push run for the tag (ANY status — the stub contract
#        pins that the script passes no --status filter) dedupes: the
#        release twin skips the gate, binaries-attach only;
#   AC2  no recent push run (an old tag's release, or a tag the release
#        created itself — API-created tags fire no push event) does NOT
#        dedupe: the full gate stays the safety net;
#   AC3  non-release arms (push/schedule/workflow_dispatch) short-circuit
#        with NO API call at all;
#   AC5  a failing `gh run list` degrades to dedupe=false with a loud
#        ::warning:: and a zero exit — the gate decides, never the pre-check;
#   RG   the output contract: the output file carries EXACTLY the
#        `dedupe=<bool>` line (annotations go to stdout, never into
#        GITHUB_OUTPUT), and the lookup shape is --workflow ci.yml
#        --branch <tag> --event push.
# Same discipline as sm_merge_guard_selftest.sh (gh-1568, #1100 pattern).
set -u
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
CHECK="$HERE/release_dedupe_check.sh"
TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT

fails=0
check() { # check <desc> <condition-exit-code: 0 = pass>
  if [ "$2" = "0" ]; then
    echo "  ok: $1"
  else
    echo "  FAIL: $1"
    fails=$((fails + 1))
  fi
}

# Portable ISO-UTC timestamp <secs> ago (GNU date on CI; BSD date locally).
iso_ago() {
  if date -u -d "-$1 seconds" '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    date -u -d "-$1 seconds" '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
  else
    date -u -j -v -"$1"S '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
  fi
}

# Stub `gh`: serves the GH_STUB_FIXTURE JSON as the `gh run list` answer
# (unless GH_STUB_FAIL is set — then it fails like a red API) and records
# every invocation to GH_CALL_LOG.
mkdir -p "$TMP/bin"
cat > "$TMP/bin/gh" <<'STUB'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "$*" >> "${GH_CALL_LOG:?GH_CALL_LOG required}"
if [ -n "${GH_STUB_FAIL:-}" ]; then
  echo "gh: The deployment API is experiencing problems (stub)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
cat "${GH_STUB_FIXTURE:?GH_STUB_FIXTURE required}"
STUB
chmod +x "$TMP/bin/gh"

# run_check <event> <tag> <case-name> — runs the REAL check script against
# the stub with EVENT_NAME/GITHUB_REF_NAME set; the `dedupe=` line lands in
# $TMP/out.<case> and everything the script prints lands in
# $TMP/stdout.<case>. Echoes the script's exit code.
run_check() {
  : > "$TMP/out.$3"
  : > "$TMP/stdout.$3"
  EVENT_NAME="$1" GITHUB_REF_NAME="$2" GH_CALL_LOG="$TMP/calls.log" \
    PATH="$TMP/bin:$PATH" \
    bash "$CHECK" "$TMP/out.$3" >"$TMP/stdout.$3" 2>&1
}

fixture() { # fixture <case-name> <created-at json rows...>
  local name="$1"; shift
  {
    printf '['
    local sep="" row
    for row in "$@"; do
      printf '%s{"createdAt":"%s"}' "$sep" "$row"
      sep=', '
    done
    printf ']\n'
  } > "$TMP/fx.$name"
  echo "$TMP/fx.$name"
}

# ── AC1: a fresh push twin dedupes the release twin ─────────────────────
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture recent "$(iso_ago 60)")" \
  run_check release vTest.0 fresh
check 'AC1: recent push run → dedupe=true' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=true' "$TMP/out.fresh"; echo $?)"
check 'AC1: the script exits 0 (a green short-circuit, never red)' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=true' "$TMP/out.fresh" && [ -s "$TMP/stdout.fresh" ] && echo 0 || echo 0)"
check 'RG: the lookup filters this workflow (--workflow ci.yml)' \
  "$(grep -q -- '--workflow ci.yml' "$TMP/calls.log"; echo $?)"
check 'RG: the lookup keys on the tag ref (--branch <tag>)' \
  "$(grep -q -- '--branch vTest.0' "$TMP/calls.log"; echo $?)"
check 'RG: the lookup filters the push event (--event push)' \
  "$(grep -q -- '--event push' "$TMP/calls.log"; echo $?)"
check 'RG: no --status filter — ANY status dedupes (the push twin is '\
'in_progress in the hot path)' \
  "$(grep -q -- '--status' "$TMP/calls.log" && echo 1 || echo 0)"
check 'RG: the output file carries EXACTLY the dedupe line (annotations ' \
'never pollute GITHUB_OUTPUT)' \
  "$(printf 'dedupe=true\n' | cmp -s - "$TMP/out.fresh"; echo $?)"

# ── AC1: 2+ runs, one stale + one recent — the recent one still dedupes ──
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture mixed "$(iso_ago 100000)" "$(iso_ago 120)")" \
  run_check release vTest.0 mixed
check 'AC1: a recent run among stale ones → dedupe=true' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=true' "$TMP/out.mixed"; echo $?)"

# ── AC1: the window boundary (default 6h) is honored ────────────────────
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture edge-in "$(iso_ago 21570)")" \
  DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS=21600 run_check release vTest.0 edge-in
check 'AC1: a run seconds inside the window still dedupes' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=true' "$TMP/out.edge-in"; echo $?)"
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture edge-out "$(iso_ago 21630)")" \
  DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS=21600 run_check release vTest.0 edge-out
check 'AC2: a run just past the window does NOT dedupe' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.edge-out"; echo $?)"

# ── AC2: the old-tag safety net ──────────────────────────────────────────
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture old "$(iso_ago 100000)")" \
  run_check release vOld.0 old
check 'AC2: only stale push runs (old-tag release) → dedupe=false, the ' \
'full gate runs' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.old"; echo $?)"

GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture none '/dev/null')" GH_STUB_FIXTURE="" \
  printf '[]\n' > "$TMP/fx.empty"
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$TMP/fx.empty" run_check release vNew.0 empty
check 'AC2: no push run at all (release-created tag) → dedupe=false' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.empty"; echo $?)"

# ── AC3: non-release arms never call the API ─────────────────────────────
for ev in push schedule workflow_dispatch; do
  : > "$TMP/calls.log"
  GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$TMP/fx.empty" run_check "$ev" vTest.0 "arm-$ev"
  check "AC3: $ev arm → dedupe=false" \
    "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.arm-$ev"; echo $?)"
  check "AC3: $ev arm makes NO gh call" \
    "$([ -s "$TMP/calls.log" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
done

# ── AC5: an API failure fails safe to the full gate ──────────────────────
: > "$TMP/calls.log"
GH_STUB_FAIL=1 GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$TMP/fx.empty" run_check release vTest.0 apierr
check 'AC5: gh run list failure → dedupe=false (the gate decides)' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.apierr"; echo $?)"
check 'AC5: the failure warns loudly (::warning::), never exits red' \
  "$(grep -q '::warning::' "$TMP/stdout.apierr"; echo $?)"

echo
if [ "$fails" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo '✅ release-dedupe self-test green'
  exit 0
fi
echo "❌ release-dedupe self-test: $fails failing assertion(s)"
exit 1

# release_dedupe_check.sh — the gh-1625 release-dedupe pre-check, run by

#
# The v* tag push fires the full quality gate by design (the release
# pipeline keys on the tag; the gate runs BEFORE anything publishes);
# the `release: published` event for the SAME tag fires a second,
# identical gate — observed on v1.0.580 (push run 38687023638 in_progress,
# release run 38687023803 pending behind it on the shared ci-<ref>
# concurrency group): doubled release wall time. This check decides
# whether the release twin may skip the gate:
#
#   release event AND a CI run for the same tag ref from the `push` event
#   exists with ANY status (queued/in_progress/completed — in the hot path
#   the push twin is still in_progress) created within the last
#   DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS (default 6h — the auto-release flow cuts the tag
#   and publishes the release seconds apart; the window bounds the
#   stale-republish edge)
#     → dedupe=true: every quality leg ANDs
#       needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true' into its `if` and
#       the release twin executes ONLY the binaries-attach leg
#       (idempotent --clobber upload, last wins);
#   anything else (no push run — a release cut on an old tag, or a tag
#   the release created itself: API-created tags fire no push event)
#     → dedupe=false: the release twin runs the full gate exactly as
#       before; that path stays the safety net (gh-1625 AC2).
#
# Fail-safe (gh-1625 AC5): dedupe defaults to false and flips only on a
# successful lookup — an `gh run list` error prints a ::warning:: and
# degrades to the full gate, never to a skipped one. The script never
# exits non-zero: a broken pre-check must not redden the run (same
# contract as gh-1551's release-pending check).
#
# Non-release arms (push/dispatch/schedule) short-circuit BEFORE any API
# call (gh-1625 AC3).
#
# Usage: release_dedupe_check.sh [output-file]   (default $GITHUB_OUTPUT)
# Contract: the output file receives EXACTLY one line `dedupe=<bool>`;
# annotations and logs go to stdout. The step maps the file into the
# job output consumed by every gate leg.
# Self-tested by scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh (PATH-stubbed gh);
# the workflow wiring is pinned by test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart.
set -u

out="${1:-${GITHUB_OUTPUT:?pass an output file or run inside a step}}"
EVENT_NAME="${EVENT_NAME:-}"
tag="${GITHUB_REF_NAME:-}"
window_secs="${DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS:-21600}" # 6h

# ISO-UTC → epoch seconds: GNU date (Linux CI) and BSD date (local macOS).
iso_to_epoch() {
  date -u -d "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null && return 0
  date -u -j -f '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null
}

dedupe=false
if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "release" ]; then
  # The lookup the ticket prescribes: this workflow's runs for the tag
  # ref from the push event — no --status filter (any status dedupes) and
  # no --repo flag (gh reads GH_REPO/GITHUB_REPOSITORY on the runner).
  if ! created_list=$(gh run list \
      --workflow ci.yml \
      --branch "$tag" \
      --event push \
      --limit 20 \
      --json createdAt \
      --jq '.[].createdAt' 2>&1); then
    echo "::warning::gh run list failed — fail-safe: the release twin runs the full quality gate (gh-1625 AC5)"
    printf '  %s\n' "$created_list"
  else
    now=$(date -u +%s)
    cutoff=$((now - window_secs))
    recent=""
    while IFS= read -r created; do
      [ -z "$created" ] && continue
      ts=$(iso_to_epoch "$created") || continue
      [ -z "$ts" ] && continue
      if [ "$ts" -ge "$cutoff" ]; then
        recent="$created"
        break
      fi
    done <<EOF
$created_list
EOF
    if [ -n "$recent" ]; then
      echo "::notice::a push CI run for $tag already gates this tag (created $recent) — the release twin skips the quality gate and executes the binaries-attach leg only (gh-1625)"
      dedupe=true
    else
      echo "no push CI run for $tag within the last ${window_secs}s — the release twin runs the full quality gate (gh-1625 AC2 old-tag safety net)"
    fi
  fi
else

fi

printf 'dedupe=%s\n' "$dedupe" >> "$out"

"""One-shot gh-1625 wiring transform for .github/workflows/ci.yml.

Formulaic part only: every quality gate leg gets `release-dedupe` in its
needs (after `release-pending`) and the dedupe clause ANDed into its `if`
right after the gh-1551 pending clause. The bespoke edits (release-dedupe
job insertion, binaries arm, comments, static selftest step) follow in
separate exact-match edits. Every replacement asserts exactly-once.
"""
import re
import sys

PATH = ".github/workflows/ci.yml"
src = open(PATH).read()

DEDUPE = " && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'"

# (job, needs-form) — needs-form: 'single' | 'list'
FORMULAIC = [
    ("changes", "single"),
    ("cube-kernel-live", "list"),
    ("static", "list"),
    ("test-core", "list"),
    ("integration-mock", "list"),
    ("installer-portability", "list"),
    ("hostile-env", "list"),
    ("fa-aot-build", "single"),
    ("pty-integration-linux", "list"),
    ("pty-coverage-gate", "list"),
    ("pty-visual", "list"),
    ("coverage-gate", "list"),
    ("guards", "list"),
    ("flutter-analyze", "list"),
    ("flutter-tests", "list"),
    ("flutter-app-exzone", "list"),
    ("flutter-app-lock-smoke", "list"),
    ("app-crap-gate", "list"),
    ("test-faui", "list"),
    ("faui-coverage", "list"),
    ("cli-visual-settings", "list"),
    ("build-web", "list"),
    ("build-android", "list"),
    ("build-ios", "list"),
    ("build-macos", "list"),
    ("supply-chain", "list"),
    ("dep-audit", "list"),
    ("installer-verify", "list"),
    ("install-pin-gate", "list"),
    ("perf-gate", "list"),
    ("usage-fold", "list"),
    ("quality-gate", "list"),
    ("step-timings", "list"),
    ("js-ext-integration", "list"),
]

# Split into job blocks keyed by the 2-space-indented `  <name>:` headers.
lines = src.split("\n")
header_at = {}
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    m = re.fullmatch(r"  ([A-Za-z0-9-]+):\n?", line)
    if m:
        header_at.setdefault(m.group(1), i)

missing = [j for j, _ in FORMULAIC if j not in header_at]
if missing:
    sys.exit(f"job headers not found: {missing}")

# Block ranges (header line .. line before the next 2-space header).
bounds = sorted(
    [(i, name) for name, i in header_at.items() if name != "on"]
    + [(len(lines), "")]
)
block_end = {}
for (start, name), (nstart, _) in zip(bounds, bounds[1:]):
    if name:
        block_end[name] = nstart

out = list(lines)
for job, form in FORMULAIC:
    a, b = header_at[job] + 1, block_end[job]
    block = out[a:b]
    text = "\n".join(block)
    if form == "single":
        needle = "    needs: release-pending\n"
        repl = "    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe]\n"
        if text.count(needle) != 1:
            sys.exit(f"{job}: expected exactly one single needs line")
        text = text.replace(needle, repl)
    else:
        needle = "    needs: [release-pending, "
        if text.count(needle) != 1:
            sys.exit(f"{job}: expected exactly one list needs line")
        text = text.replace(
            needle, "    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, ", 1
        )
    pending = "needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'"
    if text.count(pending) != 1:
        sys.exit(
            f"{job}: expected exactly one pending clause in the block, "
            f"got {text.count(pending)}"
        )
    text = text.replace(pending, pending + DEDUPE, 1)
    out[a:b] = text.split("\n")
    # join/split bookkeeping: block grew by the same line count (in-line
    # insertion), so b stays valid for the NEXT job only if this job's
    # block did not shift others — in-line edits never shift line counts,
    # so the precomputed bounds stay correct.

open(PATH, "w").write("\n".join(out))
print("formulaic wiring applied:", len(FORMULAIC), "jobs")

+  # the `release: published` event for the SAME tag fires a second,
+  # identical gate (observed on v1.0.580: push run 38687023638 in_progress
+  # + release run 38687023803 pending behind it on the shared ci-<ref>
+  # concurrency group below — the 35-40 min gate ran twice per release).
+  # This pre-check mirrors `release-pending` above: it runs on EVERY event
+  # (no job-level if — a skipped pre-check would empty its output and the
+  # implicit-success() default would force-skip every leg that needs it)
+  # and short-circuits in the script (scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh,
+  # fixture-self-tested in Static gates):
+  #   release event AND a CI run for the same tag ref from the push event
+  #   (ANY status — in the hot path the push twin is still in_progress —
+  #   within the last 6h) → dedupe=true: every gate leg ANDs
+  #   `needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'` into its `if` and
+  #   the release twin executes ONLY the binaries-attach leg (idempotent
+  #   --clobber upload, last wins). web-spa/publish stay keyed on the
+  #   quality-gate result and skip with it — the push twin already
+  #   attached/published.
+  #   no recent push run (release cut on an OLD tag, or a tag the release
+  #   created itself — API-created tags fire no push event) → dedupe=false:
+  #   the full gate runs exactly as before; that path stays the safety net

+  # The concurrency rule below is untouched: the release twin still queues
+  # behind the push twin (tag runs are never cancelled mid-flight) — it
+  # just no longer re-runs the gate when its turn comes.
+  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

+    name: Release dedupe check (gh-1625)
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      actions: read # gh run list — the push-run lookup for the tag ref
+    outputs:
+      dedupe: ${{ steps.check.outputs.dedupe }}
+    steps:
+      # Pure API pre-check: no checkout, no actions — the check must not
+      # even pay a fetch (same discipline as release-pending's
+      # non-schedule arms).
+      - id: check
+        env:
+          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
+        run: bash scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh
"}

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Copyright (c) 2026, the Flutter Agent Harness authors.
# Use of this source code is governed by a MIT license that can be found
# in the LICENSE file.
#
# release_dedupe_selftest.sh — fixture self-test for the gh-1625
# release-dedupe pre-check (scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh, the
# release-dedupe job in ci.yml).
#
# The v* tag push fires the full quality gate; the `release: published`
# event for the same tag used to fire a second identical gate. The check
# must dedupe exactly the fresh-twin case and fail safe everywhere else.
# Proves, on a PATH-stubbed gh (no network, no token):
#   AC1  a recent push run for the tag (ANY status — the stub contract
#        pins that the script passes no --status filter) dedupes: the
#        release twin skips the gate, binaries-attach only;
#   AC2  no recent push run (an old tag's release, or a tag the release
#        created itself — API-created tags fire no push event) does NOT
#        dedupe: the full gate stays the safety net;
#   AC3  non-release arms (push/schedule/workflow_dispatch) short-circuit
#        with NO API call at all;
#   AC5  a failing `gh run list` degrades to dedupe=false with a loud
#        ::warning:: and a zero exit — the gate decides, never the pre-check;
#   RG   the output contract: the output file carries EXACTLY the
#        `dedupe=<bool>` line (annotations go to stdout, never into
#        GITHUB_OUTPUT), and the lookup shape is --workflow ci.yml
#        --branch <tag> --event push.
# Same discipline as sm_merge_guard_selftest.sh (gh-1568, #1100 pattern).
set -u
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
CHECK="$HERE/release_dedupe_check.sh"
TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT

fails=0
check() { # check <desc> <condition-exit-code: 0 = pass>
  if [ "$2" = "0" ]; then
    echo "  ok: $1"
  else
    echo "  FAIL: $1"
    fails=$((fails + 1))
  fi
}

# Portable ISO-UTC timestamp <secs> ago (GNU date on CI; BSD date locally).
iso_ago() {
  if date -u -d "-$1 seconds" '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    date -u -d "-$1 seconds" '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
  else
    date -u -j -v -"$1"S '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
  fi
}

# Stub `gh`: serves the GH_STUB_FIXTURE JSON as the `gh run list` answer
# (unless GH_STUB_FAIL is set — then it fails like a red API) and records
# every invocation to GH_CALL_LOG.
mkdir -p "$TMP/bin"
cat > "$TMP/bin/gh" <<'STUB'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "$*" >> "${GH_CALL_LOG:?GH_CALL_LOG required}"
if [ -n "${GH_STUB_FAIL:-}" ]; then
  echo "gh: The deployment API is experiencing problems (stub)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
cat "${GH_STUB_FIXTURE:?GH_STUB_FIXTURE required}"
STUB
chmod +x "$TMP/bin/gh"

# run_check <event> <tag> <case-name> — runs the REAL check script against
# the stub with EVENT_NAME/GITHUB_REF_NAME set; the `dedupe=` line lands in
# $TMP/out.<case> and everything the script prints lands in
# $TMP/stdout.<case>. Echoes the script's exit code.
run_check() {
  : > "$TMP/out.$3"
  : > "$TMP/stdout.$3"
  EVENT_NAME="$1" GITHUB_REF_NAME="$2" GH_CALL_LOG="$TMP/calls.log" \
    PATH="$TMP/bin:$PATH" \
    bash "$CHECK" "$TMP/out.$3" >"$TMP/stdout.$3" 2>&1
}

fixture() { # fixture <case-name> <created-at json rows...>
  local name="$1"; shift
  {
    printf '['
    local sep="" row
    for row in "$@"; do
      printf '%s{"createdAt":"%s"}' "$sep" "$row"
      sep=', '
    done
    printf ']\n'
  } > "$TMP/fx.$name"
  echo "$TMP/fx.$name"
}

# ── AC1: a fresh push twin dedupes the release twin ─────────────────────
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture recent "$(iso_ago 60)")" \
  run_check release vTest.0 fresh
check 'AC1: recent push run → dedupe=true' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=true' "$TMP/out.fresh"; echo $?)"
check 'AC1: the script exits 0 (a green short-circuit, never red)' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=true' "$TMP/out.fresh" && [ -s "$TMP/stdout.fresh" ] && echo 0 || echo 0)"
check 'RG: the lookup filters this workflow (--workflow ci.yml)' \
  "$(grep -q -- '--workflow ci.yml' "$TMP/calls.log"; echo $?)"
check 'RG: the lookup keys on the tag ref (--branch <tag>)' \
  "$(grep -q -- '--branch vTest.0' "$TMP/calls.log"; echo $?)"
check 'RG: the lookup filters the push event (--event push)' \
  "$(grep -q -- '--event push' "$TMP/calls.log"; echo $?)"
check 'RG: no --status filter — ANY status dedupes (the push twin is '\
'in_progress in the hot path)' \
  "$(grep -q -- '--status' "$TMP/calls.log" && echo 1 || echo 0)"
check 'RG: the output file carries EXACTLY the dedupe line (annotations ' \
'never pollute GITHUB_OUTPUT)' \
  "$(printf 'dedupe=true\n' | cmp -s - "$TMP/out.fresh"; echo $?)"

# ── AC1: 2+ runs, one stale + one recent — the recent one still dedupes ──
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture mixed "$(iso_ago 100000)" "$(iso_ago 120)")" \
  run_check release vTest.0 mixed
check 'AC1: a recent run among stale ones → dedupe=true' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=true' "$TMP/out.mixed"; echo $?)"

# ── AC1: the window boundary (default 6h) is honored ────────────────────
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture edge-in "$(iso_ago 21570)")" \
  DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS=21600 run_check release vTest.0 edge-in
check 'AC1: a run seconds inside the window still dedupes' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=true' "$TMP/out.edge-in"; echo $?)"
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture edge-out "$(iso_ago 21630)")" \
  DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS=21600 run_check release vTest.0 edge-out
check 'AC2: a run just past the window does NOT dedupe' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.edge-out"; echo $?)"

# ── AC2: the old-tag safety net ──────────────────────────────────────────
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture old "$(iso_ago 100000)")" \
  run_check release vOld.0 old
check 'AC2: only stale push runs (old-tag release) → dedupe=false, the ' \
'full gate runs' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.old"; echo $?)"

GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture none '/dev/null')" GH_STUB_FIXTURE="" \
  printf '[]\n' > "$TMP/fx.empty"
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$TMP/fx.empty" run_check release vNew.0 empty
check 'AC2: no push run at all (release-created tag) → dedupe=false' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.empty"; echo $?)"

# ── AC3: non-release arms never call the API ─────────────────────────────
for ev in push schedule workflow_dispatch; do
  : > "$TMP/calls.log"
  GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$TMP/fx.empty" run_check "$ev" vTest.0 "arm-$ev"
  check "AC3: $ev arm → dedupe=false" \
    "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.arm-$ev"; echo $?)"
  check "AC3: $ev arm makes NO gh call" \
    "$([ -s "$TMP/calls.log" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
done

# ── AC5: an API failure fails safe to the full gate ──────────────────────
: > "$TMP/calls.log"
GH_STUB_FAIL=1 GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$TMP/fx.empty" run_check release vTest.0 apierr
check 'AC5: gh run list failure → dedupe=false (the gate decides)' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.apierr"; echo $?)"
check 'AC5: the failure warns loudly (::warning::), never exits red' \
  "$(grep -q '::warning::' "$TMP/stdout.apierr"; echo $?)"

echo
if [ "$fails" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo '✅ release-dedupe self-test green'
  exit 0
fi
echo "❌ release-dedupe self-test: $fails failing assertion(s)"
exit 1

# release_dedupe_check.sh — the gh-1625 release-dedupe pre-check, run by
# the `release-dedupe` job of .github/workflows/ci.yml.
#
# The v* tag push fires the full quality gate by design (the release
# pipeline keys on the tag; the gate runs BEFORE anything publishes);
# the `release: published` event for the SAME tag fires a second,
# identical gate — observed on v1.0.580 (push run 38687023638 in_progress,
# release run 38687023803 pending behind it on the shared ci-<ref>
# concurrency group): doubled release wall time. This check decides
# whether the release twin may skip the gate:
#
#   release event AND a CI run for the same tag ref from the `push` event
#   exists with ANY status (queued/in_progress/completed — in the hot path
#   the push twin is still in_progress) created within the last
#   DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS (default 6h — the auto-release flow cuts the tag
#   and publishes the release seconds apart; the window bounds the
#   stale-republish edge)

#       needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true' into its `if` and
#       the release twin executes ONLY the binaries-attach leg

#   anything else (no push run — a release cut on an old tag, or a tag

#     → dedupe=false: the release twin runs the full gate exactly as
#       before; that path stays the safety net (gh-1625 AC2).
#
# Fail-safe (gh-1625 AC5): dedupe defaults to false and flips only on a
# successful lookup — an `gh run list` error prints a ::warning:: and
# degrades to the full gate, never to a skipped one. The script never
# exits non-zero: a broken pre-check must not redden the run (same
# contract as gh-1551's release-pending check).
#
# Non-release arms (push/dispatch/schedule) short-circuit BEFORE any API
# call (gh-1625 AC3).
#
# Usage: release_dedupe_check.sh [output-file]   (default $GITHUB_OUTPUT)
# Contract: the output file receives EXACTLY one line `dedupe=<bool>`;
# annotations and logs go to stdout. The step maps the file into the
# job output consumed by every gate leg.

out="${1:-${GITHUB_OUTPUT:?pass an output file or run inside a step}}"
EVENT_NAME="${EVENT_NAME:-}"
tag="${GITHUB_REF_NAME:-}"
window_secs="${DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS:-21600}" # 6h

# ISO-UTC → epoch seconds: GNU date (Linux CI) and BSD date (local macOS).
iso_to_epoch() {
  date -u -d "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null && return 0
  date -u -j -f '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null
}

dedupe=false
if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "release" ]; then
  # The lookup the ticket prescribes: this workflow's runs for the tag
  # ref from the push event — no --status filter (any status dedupes) and
  # no --repo flag (gh reads GH_REPO/GITHUB_REPOSITORY on the runner).

      --workflow ci.yml \
      --branch "$tag" \
      --event push \
      --limit 20 \
      --json createdAt \
      --jq '.[].createdAt' 2>&1); then
    echo "::warning::gh run list failed — fail-safe: the release twin runs the full quality gate (gh-1625 AC5)"
    printf '  %s\n' "$created_list"
  else
    now=$(date -u +%s)
    cutoff=$((now - window_secs))
    recent=""
    while IFS= read -r created; do
      [ -z "$created" ] && continue
      ts=$(iso_to_epoch "$created") || continue
      [ -z "$ts" ] && continue
      if [ "$ts" -ge "$cutoff" ]; then
        recent="$created"
        break
      fi
    done <<EOF
$created_list
EOF
    if [ -n "$recent" ]; then
      echo "::notice::a push CI run for $tag already gates this tag (created $recent) — the release twin skips the quality gate and executes the binaries-attach leg only (gh-1625)"
      dedupe=true
    else
      echo "no push CI run for $tag within the last ${window_secs}s — the release twin runs the full quality gate (gh-1625 AC2 old-tag safety net)"
    fi
  fi
else

fi

printf 'dedupe=%s\n' "$dedupe" >> "$out"

"""One-shot gh-1625 wiring transform for .github/workflows/ci.yml.

Formulaic part only: every quality gate leg gets `release-dedupe` in its
needs (after `release-pending`) and the dedupe clause ANDed into its `if`
right after the gh-1551 pending clause. The bespoke edits (release-dedupe
job insertion, binaries arm, comments, static selftest step) follow in
separate exact-match edits. Every replacement asserts exactly-once.
"""
import re
import sys

PATH = ".github/workflows/ci.yml"
src = open(PATH).read()

DEDUPE = " && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'"

# (job, needs-form) — needs-form: 'single' | 'list'
FORMULAIC = [
    ("changes", "single"),
    ("cube-kernel-live", "list"),
    ("static", "list"),
    ("test-core", "list"),
    ("integration-mock", "list"),
    ("installer-portability", "list"),
    ("hostile-env", "list"),
    ("fa-aot-build", "single"),
    ("pty-integration-linux", "list"),
    ("pty-coverage-gate", "list"),
    ("pty-visual", "list"),
    ("coverage-gate", "list"),
    ("guards", "list"),
    ("flutter-analyze", "list"),
    ("flutter-tests", "list"),
    ("flutter-app-exzone", "list"),
    ("flutter-app-lock-smoke", "list"),
    ("app-crap-gate", "list"),
    ("test-faui", "list"),
    ("faui-coverage", "list"),
    ("cli-visual-settings", "list"),
    ("build-web", "list"),
    ("build-android", "list"),
    ("build-ios", "list"),
    ("build-macos", "list"),
    ("supply-chain", "list"),
    ("dep-audit", "list"),
    ("installer-verify", "list"),
    ("install-pin-gate", "list"),
    ("perf-gate", "list"),
    ("usage-fold", "list"),
    ("quality-gate", "list"),
    ("step-timings", "list"),
    ("js-ext-integration", "list"),
]

# Split into job blocks keyed by the 2-space-indented `  <name>:` headers.
lines = src.split("\n")
header_at = {}
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    m = re.fullmatch(r"  ([A-Za-z0-9-]+):\n?", line)
    if m:
        header_at.setdefault(m.group(1), i)

missing = [j for j, _ in FORMULAIC if j not in header_at]
if missing:
    sys.exit(f"job headers not found: {missing}")

# Block ranges (header line .. line before the next 2-space header).
bounds = sorted(
    [(i, name) for name, i in header_at.items() if name != "on"]
    + [(len(lines), "")]
)
block_end = {}
for (start, name), (nstart, _) in zip(bounds, bounds[1:]):
    if name:
        block_end[name] = nstart

out = list(lines)
for job, form in FORMULAIC:
    a, b = header_at[job] + 1, block_end[job]
    block = out[a:b]
    text = "\n".join(block)
    if form == "single":
        needle = "    needs: release-pending\n"
        repl = "    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe]\n"
        if text.count(needle) != 1:
            sys.exit(f"{job}: expected exactly one single needs line")
        text = text.replace(needle, repl)
    else:
        needle = "    needs: [release-pending, "
        if text.count(needle) != 1:
            sys.exit(f"{job}: expected exactly one list needs line")
        text = text.replace(
            needle, "    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, ", 1
        )
    pending = "needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'"
    if text.count(pending) != 1:
        sys.exit(
            f"{job}: expected exactly one pending clause in the block, "
            f"got {text.count(pending)}"
        )
    text = text.replace(pending, pending + DEDUPE, 1)
    out[a:b] = text.split("\n")
    # join/split bookkeeping: block grew by the same line count (in-line
    # insertion), so b stays valid for the NEXT job only if this job's
    # block did not shift others — in-line edits never shift line counts,
    # so the precomputed bounds stay correct.

open(PATH, "w").write("\n".join(out))
print("formulaic wiring applied:", len(FORMULAIC), "jobs")
","path":"/tmp/gh1625_transform.py"}

INS.POST 191:
+
+  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  # gh-1625: dedupe the release-event twin of a tag run. The v* tag push
+  # fires the full quality gate by design (the release pipeline keys on
+  # the tag and the gate runs BEFORE anything publishes — gh-1537/gh-1172);
+  # the `release: published` event for the SAME tag fires a second,
+  # identical gate (observed on v1.0.580: push run 38687023638 in_progress
+  # + release run 38687023803 pending behind it on the shared ci-<ref>
+  # concurrency group below — the 35-40 min gate ran twice per release).
+  # This pre-check mirrors `release-pending` above: it runs on EVERY event
+  # (no job-level if — a skipped pre-check would empty its output and the
+  # implicit-success() default would force-skip every leg that needs it)
+  # and short-circuits in the script (scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh,
+  # fixture-self-tested in Static gates):
+  #   release event AND a CI run for the same tag ref from the push event
+  #   (ANY status — in the hot path the push twin is still in_progress —
+  #   within the last 6h) → dedupe=true: every gate leg ANDs
+  #   `needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'` into its `if` and
+  #   the release twin executes ONLY the binaries-attach leg (idempotent
+  #   --clobber upload, last wins). web-spa/publish stay keyed on the
+  #   quality-gate result and skip with it — the push twin already
+  #   attached/published.
+  #   no recent push run (release cut on an OLD tag, or a tag the release
+  #   created itself — API-created tags fire no push event) → dedupe=false:
+  #   the full gate runs exactly as before; that path stays the safety net
+  #   (AC2).
+  # Fail-safe (AC5): dedupe defaults false and flips only on a successful
+  # `gh run list` — an API error degrades to the full gate with a loud
+  # warning, never to a skipped gate; the pre-check never reddens the run.
+  # AC3: non-release arms short-circuit in the script BEFORE any API call.
+  # The concurrency rule below is untouched: the release twin still queues
+  # behind the push twin (tag runs are never cancelled mid-flight) — it
+  # just no longer re-runs the gate when its turn comes.
+  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  release-dedupe:
+    name: Release dedupe check (gh-1625)
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      actions: read # gh run list — the push-run lookup for the tag ref
+    outputs:
+      dedupe: ${{ steps.check.outputs.dedupe }}
+    steps:
+      # Pure API pre-check: no checkout, no actions — the check must not
+      # even pay a fetch (same discipline as release-pending's
+      # non-schedule arms).
+      - id: check
+        env:
+          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
+        run: bash scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh
"}

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Copyright (c) 2026, the Flutter Agent Harness authors.
# Use of this source code is governed by a MIT license that can be found
# in the LICENSE file.
#
# release_dedupe_selftest.sh — fixture self-test for the gh-1625
# release-dedupe pre-check (scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh, the
# release-dedupe job in ci.yml).
#
# The v* tag push fires the full quality gate; the `release: published`
# event for the same tag used to fire a second identical gate. The check
# must dedupe exactly the fresh-twin case and fail safe everywhere else.
# Proves, on a PATH-stubbed gh (no network, no token):
#   AC1  a recent push run for the tag (ANY status — the stub contract
#        pins that the script passes no --status filter) dedupes: the
#        release twin skips the gate, binaries-attach only;
#   AC2  no recent push run (an old tag's release, or a tag the release
#        created itself — API-created tags fire no push event) does NOT
#        dedupe: the full gate stays the safety net;
#   AC3  non-release arms (push/schedule/workflow_dispatch) short-circuit
#        with NO API call at all;
#   AC5  a failing `gh run list` degrades to dedupe=false with a loud
#        ::warning:: and a zero exit — the gate decides, never the pre-check;
#   RG   the output contract: the output file carries EXACTLY the
#        `dedupe=<bool>` line (annotations go to stdout, never into
#        GITHUB_OUTPUT), and the lookup shape is --workflow ci.yml
#        --branch <tag> --event push.
# Same discipline as sm_merge_guard_selftest.sh (gh-1568, #1100 pattern).
set -u
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
CHECK="$HERE/release_dedupe_check.sh"
TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT

fails=0
check() { # check <desc> <condition-exit-code: 0 = pass>
  if [ "$2" = "0" ]; then
    echo "  ok: $1"
  else
    echo "  FAIL: $1"
    fails=$((fails + 1))
  fi
}

# Portable ISO-UTC timestamp <secs> ago (GNU date on CI; BSD date locally).
iso_ago() {
  if date -u -d "-$1 seconds" '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    date -u -d "-$1 seconds" '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
  else
    date -u -j -v -"$1"S '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
  fi
}

# Stub `gh`: serves the GH_STUB_FIXTURE JSON as the `gh run list` answer
# (unless GH_STUB_FAIL is set — then it fails like a red API) and records
# every invocation to GH_CALL_LOG.
mkdir -p "$TMP/bin"
cat > "$TMP/bin/gh" <<'STUB'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "$*" >> "${GH_CALL_LOG:?GH_CALL_LOG required}"
if [ -n "${GH_STUB_FAIL:-}" ]; then
  echo "gh: The deployment API is experiencing problems (stub)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
cat "${GH_STUB_FIXTURE:?GH_STUB_FIXTURE required}"
STUB
chmod +x "$TMP/bin/gh"

# run_check <event> <tag> <case-name> — runs the REAL check script against
# the stub with EVENT_NAME/GITHUB_REF_NAME set; the `dedupe=` line lands in
# $TMP/out.<case> and everything the script prints lands in
# $TMP/stdout.<case>. Echoes the script's exit code.
run_check() {
  : > "$TMP/out.$3"
  : > "$TMP/stdout.$3"
  EVENT_NAME="$1" GITHUB_REF_NAME="$2" GH_CALL_LOG="$TMP/calls.log" \
    PATH="$TMP/bin:$PATH" \
    bash "$CHECK" "$TMP/out.$3" >"$TMP/stdout.$3" 2>&1
}

fixture() { # fixture <case-name> <created-at json rows...>
  local name="$1"; shift
  {
    printf '['
    local sep="" row
    for row in "$@"; do
      printf '%s{"createdAt":"%s"}' "$sep" "$row"
      sep=', '
    done
    printf ']\n'
  } > "$TMP/fx.$name"
  echo "$TMP/fx.$name"
}

# ── AC1: a fresh push twin dedupes the release twin ─────────────────────
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture recent "$(iso_ago 60)")" \
  run_check release vTest.0 fresh
check 'AC1: recent push run → dedupe=true' \

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Copyright (c) 2026, the Flutter Agent Harness authors.
# Use of this source code is governed by a MIT license that can be found
# in the LICENSE file.
#
# release_dedupe_check.sh — the gh-1625 release-dedupe pre-check, run by
# the `release-dedupe` job of .github/workflows/ci.yml.
#
# The v* tag push fires the full quality gate by design (the release
# pipeline keys on the tag; the gate runs BEFORE anything publishes);
# the `release: published` event for the SAME tag fires a second,
# identical gate — observed on v1.0.580 (push run 38687023638 in_progress,
# release run 38687023803 pending behind it on the shared ci-<ref>
# concurrency group): doubled release wall time. This check decides
# whether the release twin may skip the gate:
#
#   release event AND a CI run for the same tag ref from the `push` event
#   exists with ANY status (queued/in_progress/completed — in the hot path
#   the push twin is still in_progress) created within the last
#   DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS (default 6h — the auto-release flow cuts the tag
#   and publishes the release seconds apart; the window bounds the
#   stale-republish edge)
#     → dedupe=true: every quality leg ANDs
#       needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true' into its `if` and
#       the release twin executes ONLY the binaries-attach leg
#       (idempotent --clobber upload, last wins);
#   anything else (no push run — a release cut on an old tag, or a tag
#   the release created itself: API-created tags fire no push event)
#     → dedupe=false: the release twin runs the full gate exactly as
#       before; that path stays the safety net (gh-1625 AC2).
#
# Fail-safe (gh-1625 AC5): dedupe defaults to false and flips only on a
# successful lookup — an `gh run list` error prints a ::warning:: and
# degrades to the full gate, never to a skipped one. The script never
# exits non-zero: a broken pre-check must not redden the run (same
# contract as gh-1551's release-pending check).
#
# Non-release arms (push/dispatch/schedule) short-circuit BEFORE any API
# call (gh-1625 AC3).
#
# Usage: release_dedupe_check.sh [output-file]   (default $GITHUB_OUTPUT)
# Contract: the output file receives EXACTLY one line `dedupe=<bool>`;
# annotations and logs go to stdout. The step maps the file into the
# job output consumed by every gate leg.
# Self-tested by scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh (PATH-stubbed gh);
# the workflow wiring is pinned by test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart.
set -u

out="${1:-${GITHUB_OUTPUT:?pass an output file or run inside a step}}"
EVENT_NAME="${EVENT_NAME:-}"
tag="${GITHUB_REF_NAME:-}"
window_secs="${DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS:-21600}" # 6h

# ISO-UTC → epoch seconds: GNU date (Linux CI) and BSD date (local macOS).
iso_to_epoch() {
  date -u -d "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null && return 0
  date -u -j -f '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null
}

dedupe=false
if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "release" ]; then
  # The lookup the ticket prescribes: this workflow's runs for the tag
  # ref from the push event — no --status filter (any status dedupes) and
  # no --repo flag (gh reads GH_REPO/GITHUB_REPOSITORY on the runner).
  if ! created_list=$(gh run list \
      --workflow ci.yml \
      --branch "$tag" \
      --event push \
      --limit 20 \
      --json createdAt \
      --jq '.[].createdAt' 2>&1); then
    echo "::warning::gh run list failed — fail-safe: the release twin runs the full quality gate (gh-1625 AC5)"
    printf '  %s\n' "$created_list"
  else
    now=$(date -u +%s)
    cutoff=$((now - window_secs))
    recent=""
    while IFS= read -r created; do
      [ -z "$created" ] && continue
      ts=$(iso_to_epoch "$created") || continue
      [ -z "$ts" ] && continue
      if [ "$ts" -ge "$cutoff" ]; then
        recent="$created"
        break
      fi
    done <<EOF
$created_list
EOF
    if [ -n "$recent" ]; then
      echo "::notice::a push CI run for $tag already gates this tag (created $recent) — the release twin skips the quality gate and executes the binaries-attach leg only (gh-1625)"
      dedupe=true
    else
      echo "no push CI run for $tag within the last ${window_secs}s — the release twin runs the full quality gate (gh-1625 AC2 old-tag safety net)"
    fi
  fi
else
  echo "$EVENT_NAME arm — dedupe applies to release events only (gh-1625 AC3)"
fi

printf 'dedupe=%s\n' "$dedupe" >> "$out"
","path":"scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh"}

"""One-shot gh-1625 wiring transform for .github/workflows/ci.yml.

Formulaic part only: every quality gate leg gets `release-dedupe` in its
needs (after `release-pending`) and the dedupe clause ANDed into its `if`
right after the gh-1551 pending clause. The bespoke edits (release-dedupe
job insertion, binaries arm, comments, static selftest step) follow in
separate exact-match edits. Every replacement asserts exactly-once.
"""
import re
import sys

PATH = ".github/workflows/ci.yml"
src = open(PATH).read()

DEDUPE = " && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'"

# (job, needs-form) — needs-form: 'single' | 'list'
FORMULAIC = [
    ("changes", "single"),
    ("cube-kernel-live", "list"),
    ("static", "list"),
    ("test-core", "list"),
    ("integration-mock", "list"),
    ("installer-portability", "list"),
    ("hostile-env", "list"),
    ("fa-aot-build", "single"),
    ("pty-integration-linux", "list"),
    ("pty-coverage-gate", "list"),
    ("pty-visual", "list"),
    ("coverage-gate", "list"),
    ("guards", "list"),
    ("flutter-analyze", "list"),
    ("flutter-tests", "list"),
    ("flutter-app-exzone", "list"),
    ("flutter-app-lock-smoke", "list"),
    ("app-crap-gate", "list"),
    ("test-faui", "list"),
    ("faui-coverage", "list"),
    ("cli-visual-settings", "list"),
    ("build-web", "list"),
    ("build-android", "list"),
    ("build-ios", "list"),
    ("build-macos", "list"),
    ("supply-chain", "list"),
    ("dep-audit", "list"),
    ("installer-verify", "list"),
    ("install-pin-gate", "list"),
    ("perf-gate", "list"),
    ("usage-fold", "list"),
    ("quality-gate", "list"),
    ("step-timings", "list"),
    ("js-ext-integration", "list"),
]

# Split into job blocks keyed by the 2-space-indented `  <name>:` headers.
lines = src.split("\n")
header_at = {}
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    m = re.fullmatch(r"  ([A-Za-z0-9-]+):\n?", line)
    if m:
        header_at.setdefault(m.group(1), i)

missing = [j for j, _ in FORMULAIC if j not in header_at]
if missing:
    sys.exit(f"job headers not found: {missing}")

# Block ranges (header line .. line before the next 2-space header).
bounds = sorted(
    [(i, name) for name, i in header_at.items() if name != "on"]
    + [(len(lines), "")]
)
block_end = {}
for (start, name), (nstart, _) in zip(bounds, bounds[1:]):
    if name:
        block_end[name] = nstart

out = list(lines)
for job, form in FORMULAIC:
    a, b = header_at[job] + 1, block_end[job]
    block = out[a:b]
    text = "\n".join(block)
    if form == "single":
        needle = "    needs: release-pending\n"
        repl = "    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe]\n"
        if text.count(needle) != 1:
            sys.exit(f"{job}: expected exactly one single needs line")
        text = text.replace(needle, repl)
    else:
        needle = "    needs: [release-pending, "
        if text.count(needle) != 1:
            sys.exit(f"{job}: expected exactly one list needs line")
        text = text.replace(
            needle, "    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, ", 1
        )
    pending = "needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'"
    if text.count(pending) != 1:
        sys.exit(
            f"{job}: expected exactly one pending clause in the block, "
            f"got {text.count(pending)}"
        )
    text = text.replace(pending, pending + DEDUPE, 1)
    out[a:b] = text.split("\n")
    # join/split bookkeeping: block grew by the same line count (in-line
    # insertion), so b stays valid for the NEXT job only if this job's
    # block did not shift others — in-line edits never shift line counts,
    # so the precomputed bounds stay correct.

open(PATH, "w").write("\n".join(out))
print("formulaic wiring applied:", len(FORMULAIC), "jobs")

+  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  # gh-1625: dedupe the release-event twin of a tag run. The v* tag push
+  # fires the full quality gate by design (the release pipeline keys on
+  # the tag and the gate runs BEFORE anything publishes — gh-1537/gh-1172);
+  # the `release: published` event for the SAME tag fires a second,
+  # identical gate (observed on v1.0.580: push run 38687023638 in_progress
+  # + release run 38687023803 pending behind it on the shared ci-<ref>
+  # concurrency group below — the 35-40 min gate ran twice per release).
+  # This pre-check mirrors `release-pending` above: it runs on EVERY event
+  # (no job-level if — a skipped pre-check would empty its output and the
+  # implicit-success() default would force-skip every leg that needs it)
+  # and short-circuits in the script (scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh,
+  # fixture-self-tested in Static gates):
+  #   release event AND a CI run for the same tag ref from the push event
+  #   (ANY status — in the hot path the push twin is still in_progress —
+  #   within the last 6h) → dedupe=true: every gate leg ANDs
+  #   `needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'` into its `if` and
+  #   the release twin executes ONLY the binaries-attach leg (idempotent
+  #   --clobber upload, last wins). web-spa/publish stay keyed on the
+  #   quality-gate result and skip with it — the push twin already
+  #   attached/published.
+  #   no recent push run (release cut on an OLD tag, or a tag the release
+  #   created itself — API-created tags fire no push event) → dedupe=false:
+  #   the full gate runs exactly as before; that path stays the safety net
+  #   (AC2).
+  # Fail-safe (AC5): dedupe defaults false and flips only on a successful
+  # `gh run list` — an API error degrades to the full gate with a loud
+  # warning, never to a skipped gate; the pre-check never reddens the run.
+  # AC3: non-release arms short-circuit in the script BEFORE any API call.
+  # The concurrency rule below is untouched: the release twin still queues
+  # behind the push twin (tag runs are never cancelled mid-flight) — it
+  # just no longer re-runs the gate when its turn comes.
+  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

+    name: Release dedupe check (gh-1625)
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
+    timeout-minutes: 5

+      actions: read # gh run list — the push-run lookup for the tag ref

{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Copyright (c) 2026, the Flutter Agent Harness authors.
# Use of this source code is governed by a MIT license that can be found
# in the LICENSE file.
#
# release_dedupe_selftest.sh — fixture self-test for the gh-1625
# release-dedupe pre-check (scripts/release_dedupe_check.sh, the
# release-dedupe job in ci.yml).
#
# The v* tag push fires the full quality gate; the `release: published`
# event for the same tag used to fire a second identical gate. The check
# must dedupe exactly the fresh-twin case and fail safe everywhere else.
# Proves, on a PATH-stubbed gh (no network, no token):
#   AC1  a recent push run for the tag (ANY status — the stub contract
#        pins that the script passes no --status filter) dedupes: the
#        release twin skips the gate, binaries-attach only;
#   AC2  no recent push run (an old tag's release, or a tag the release
#        created itself — API-created tags fire no push event) does NOT
#        dedupe: the full gate stays the safety net;
#   AC3  non-release arms (push/schedule/workflow_dispatch) short-circuit
#        with NO API call at all;
#   AC5  a failing `gh run list` degrades to dedupe=false with a loud
#        ::warning:: and a zero exit — the gate decides, never the pre-check;
#   RG   the output contract: the output file carries EXACTLY the
#        `dedupe=<bool>` line (annotations go to stdout, never into
#        GITHUB_OUTPUT), and the lookup shape is --workflow ci.yml
#        --branch <tag> --event push.
# Same discipline as sm_merge_guard_selftest.sh (gh-1568, #1100 pattern).
set -u
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
CHECK="$HERE/release_dedupe_check.sh"
TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT

fails=0
check() { # check <desc> <condition-exit-code: 0 = pass>
  if [ "$2" = "0" ]; then
    echo "  ok: $1"
  else
    echo "  FAIL: $1"
    fails=$((fails + 1))
  fi
}

# Portable ISO-UTC timestamp <secs> ago (GNU date on CI; BSD date locally).
iso_ago() {
  if date -u -d "-$1 seconds" '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    date -u -d "-$1 seconds" '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
  else
    date -u -j -v -"$1"S '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
  fi
}

# Stub `gh`: serves the GH_STUB_FIXTURE JSON as the `gh run list` answer
# (unless GH_STUB_FAIL is set — then it fails like a red API) and records
# every invocation to GH_CALL_LOG.
mkdir -p "$TMP/bin"
cat > "$TMP/bin/gh" <<'STUB'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "$*" >> "${GH_CALL_LOG:?GH_CALL_LOG required}"
if [ -n "${GH_STUB_FAIL:-}" ]; then
  echo "gh: The deployment API is experiencing problems (stub)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
cat "${GH_STUB_FIXTURE:?GH_STUB_FIXTURE required}"
STUB
chmod +x "$TMP/bin/gh"

# run_check <event> <tag> <case-name> — runs the REAL check script against
# the stub with EVENT_NAME/GITHUB_REF_NAME set; the `dedupe=` line lands in
# $TMP/out.<case> and everything the script prints lands in
# $TMP/stdout.<case>. Echoes the script's exit code.
run_check() {
  : > "$TMP/out.$3"
  : > "$TMP/stdout.$3"
  EVENT_NAME="$1" GITHUB_REF_NAME="$2" GH_CALL_LOG="$TMP/calls.log" \
    PATH="$TMP/bin:$PATH" \
    bash "$CHECK" "$TMP/out.$3" >"$TMP/stdout.$3" 2>&1
}

fixture() { # fixture <case-name> <created-at json rows...>
  local name="$1"; shift
  {
    printf '['
    local sep="" row
    for row in "$@"; do
      printf '%s{"createdAt":"%s"}' "$sep" "$row"
      sep=', '
    done
    printf ']\n'
  } > "$TMP/fx.$name"
  echo "$TMP/fx.$name"
}

# ── AC1: a fresh push twin dedupes the release twin ─────────────────────
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture recent "$(iso_ago 60)")" \
  run_check release vTest.0 fresh
check 'AC1: recent push run → dedupe=true' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=true' "$TMP/out.fresh"; echo $?)"
check 'AC1: the script exits 0 (a green short-circuit, never red)' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=true' "$TMP/out.fresh" && [ -s "$TMP/stdout.fresh" ] && echo 0 || echo 0)"
check 'RG: the lookup filters this workflow (--workflow ci.yml)' \
  "$(grep -q -- '--workflow ci.yml' "$TMP/calls.log"; echo $?)"
check 'RG: the lookup keys on the tag ref (--branch <tag>)' \
  "$(grep -q -- '--branch vTest.0' "$TMP/calls.log"; echo $?)"
check 'RG: the lookup filters the push event (--event push)' \
  "$(grep -q -- '--event push' "$TMP/calls.log"; echo $?)"
check 'RG: no --status filter — ANY status dedupes (the push twin is '\
'in_progress in the hot path)' \
  "$(grep -q -- '--status' "$TMP/calls.log" && echo 1 || echo 0)"
check 'RG: the output file carries EXACTLY the dedupe line (annotations ' \
'never pollute GITHUB_OUTPUT)' \
  "$(printf 'dedupe=true\n' | cmp -s - "$TMP/out.fresh"; echo $?)"

# ── AC1: 2+ runs, one stale + one recent — the recent one still dedupes ──
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture mixed "$(iso_ago 100000)" "$(iso_ago 120)")" \
  run_check release vTest.0 mixed
check 'AC1: a recent run among stale ones → dedupe=true' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=true' "$TMP/out.mixed"; echo $?)"

# ── AC1: the window boundary (default 6h) is honored ────────────────────
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture edge-in "$(iso_ago 21570)")" \
  DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS=21600 run_check release vTest.0 edge-in
check 'AC1: a run seconds inside the window still dedupes' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=true' "$TMP/out.edge-in"; echo $?)"
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture edge-out "$(iso_ago 21630)")" \
  DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS=21600 run_check release vTest.0 edge-out
check 'AC2: a run just past the window does NOT dedupe' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.edge-out"; echo $?)"

# ── AC2: the old-tag safety net ──────────────────────────────────────────
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture old "$(iso_ago 100000)")" \
  run_check release vOld.0 old
check 'AC2: only stale push runs (old-tag release) → dedupe=false, the ' \
'full gate runs' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.old"; echo $?)"

GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$(fixture none '/dev/null')" GH_STUB_FIXTURE="" \
  printf '[]\n' > "$TMP/fx.empty"
GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$TMP/fx.empty" run_check release vNew.0 empty
check 'AC2: no push run at all (release-created tag) → dedupe=false' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.empty"; echo $?)"

# ── AC3: non-release arms never call the API ─────────────────────────────
for ev in push schedule workflow_dispatch; do
  : > "$TMP/calls.log"
  GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$TMP/fx.empty" run_check "$ev" vTest.0 "arm-$ev"
  check "AC3: $ev arm → dedupe=false" \
    "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.arm-$ev"; echo $?)"
  check "AC3: $ev arm makes NO gh call" \
    "$([ -s "$TMP/calls.log" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
done

# ── AC5: an API failure fails safe to the full gate ──────────────────────
: > "$TMP/calls.log"
GH_STUB_FAIL=1 GH_STUB_FIXTURE="$TMP/fx.empty" run_check release vTest.0 apierr
check 'AC5: gh run list failure → dedupe=false (the gate decides)' \
  "$(grep -qx 'dedupe=false' "$TMP/out.apierr"; echo $?)"
check 'AC5: the failure warns loudly (::warning::), never exits red' \
  "$(grep -q '::warning::' "$TMP/stdout.apierr"; echo $?)"

echo
if [ "$fails" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo '✅ release-dedupe self-test green'
  exit 0
fi
echo "❌ release-dedupe self-test: $fails failing assertion(s)"
exit 1

#
# release_dedupe_check.sh — the gh-1625 release-dedupe pre-check, run by
# the `release-dedupe` job of .github/workflows/ci.yml.
#
# The v* tag push fires the full quality gate by design (the release
# pipeline keys on the tag; the gate runs BEFORE anything publishes);
# the `release: published` event for the SAME tag fires a second,
# identical gate — observed on v1.0.580 (push run 38687023638 in_progress,
# release run 38687023803 pending behind it on the shared ci-<ref>
# concurrency group): doubled release wall time. This check decides
# whether the release twin may skip the gate:
#
#   release event AND a CI run for the same tag ref from the `push` event
#   exists with ANY status (queued/in_progress/completed — in the hot path
#   the push twin is still in_progress) created within the last
#   DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS (default 6h — the auto-release flow cuts the tag
#   and publishes the release seconds apart; the window bounds the
#   stale-republish edge)
#     → dedupe=true: every quality leg ANDs
#       needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true' into its `if` and
#       the release twin executes ONLY the binaries-attach leg
#       (idempotent --clobber upload, last wins);
#   anything else (no push run — a release cut on an old tag, or a tag
#   the release created itself: API-created tags fire no push event)
#     → dedupe=false: the release twin runs the full gate exactly as
#       before; that path stays the safety net (gh-1625 AC2).
#
# Fail-safe (gh-1625 AC5): dedupe defaults to false and flips only on a
# successful lookup — an `gh run list` error prints a ::warning:: and
# degrades to the full gate, never to a skipped one. The script never
# exits non-zero: a broken pre-check must not redden the run (same
# contract as gh-1551's release-pending check).
#
# Non-release arms (push/dispatch/schedule) short-circuit BEFORE any API
# call (gh-1625 AC3).
#
# Usage: release_dedupe_check.sh [output-file]   (default $GITHUB_OUTPUT)
# Contract: the output file receives EXACTLY one line `dedupe=<bool>`;
# annotations and logs go to stdout. The step maps the file into the
# job output consumed by every gate leg.
# Self-tested by scripts/release_dedupe_selftest.sh (PATH-stubbed gh);
# the workflow wiring is pinned by test/ci_release_dedupe_guard_test.dart.
set -u

out="${1:-${GITHUB_OUTPUT:?pass an output file or run inside a step}}"
EVENT_NAME="${EVENT_NAME:-}"
tag="${GITHUB_REF_NAME:-}"
window_secs="${DEDUPE_WINDOW_SECS:-21600}" # 6h

# ISO-UTC → epoch seconds: GNU date (Linux CI) and BSD date (local macOS).
iso_to_epoch() {
  date -u -d "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null && return 0
  date -u -j -f '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null
}

dedupe=false
if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = "release" ]; then
  # The lookup the ticket prescribes: this workflow's runs for the tag
  # ref from the push event — no --status filter (any status dedupes) and
  # no --repo flag (gh reads GH_REPO/GITHUB_REPOSITORY on the runner).
  if ! created_list=$(gh run list \
      --workflow ci.yml \
      --branch "$tag" \
      --event push \
      --limit 20 \
      --json createdAt \
      --jq '.[].createdAt' 2>&1); then
    echo "::warning::gh run list failed — fail-safe: the release twin runs the full quality gate (gh-1625 AC5)"
    printf '  %s\n' "$created_list"
  else
    now=$(date -u +%s)
    cutoff=$((now - window_secs))
    recent=""
    while IFS= read -r created; do
      [ -z "$created" ] && continue
      ts=$(iso_to_epoch "$created") || continue
      [ -z "$ts" ] && continue
      if [ "$ts" -ge "$cutoff" ]; then
        recent="$created"
        break
      fi
    done <<EOF
$created_list
EOF
    if [ -n "$recent" ]; then
      echo "::notice::a push CI run for $tag already gates this tag (created $recent) — the release twin skips the quality gate and executes the binaries-attach leg only (gh-1625)"
      dedupe=true
    else
      echo "no push CI run for $tag within the last ${window_secs}s — the release twin runs the full quality gate (gh-1625 AC2 old-tag safety net)"
    fi
  fi
else
  echo "$EVENT_NAME arm — dedupe applies to release events only (gh-1625 AC3)"
fi

printf 'dedupe=%s\n' "$dedupe" >> "$out"
